# Listed company: listed-company (CO)

A listed company: its live quote and price history (yfinance connector) and its news headlines (news connector), both computed on demand. One row per listed company, keyed by COMPANY_ID. Read by the **news-and-markets** pack's connector `news-store` (table `<root>/news/listed-company/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/news-and-markets/samples/listed-company.jsonl`, 20 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/news-and-markets/samples/listed-company.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `COMPANY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 20 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "COMPANY_ID": "CO-AAPL",
  "TICKER": "AAPL",
  "NAME": "Apple Inc.",
  "ALIASES": [
    "Apple Inc",
    "AAPL",
    "iPhone"
  ],
  "ALIAS_TEXT": "Apple Inc, AAPL, iPhone",
  "EXCHANGE": "Nasdaq",
  "SECTOR": "Technology",
  "COUNTRY": "US",
  "ECONOMY": "ECON-USA",
  "QUOTE_ID": "QUOTE-AAPL",
  "NEWS_ID": "NEWS-Apple",
  "NEWS_ALL_ID": "NEWS-Apple~all",
  "_meta": {
    "source": "reference",
    "generation": 1,
    "live": false
  }
}
```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPANY_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^CO-` | `"CO-AAPL"` |
| `TICKER` | string | required | The company's stock exchange ticker (AAPL); the quote's and the headlines' symbol. | — | `"AAPL"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The company's name as listed (Apple Inc.). | — | `"Apple Inc."` |
| `ALIASES` | array of strings | required | Other names of the company the news connector accepts in a headline (its relevance step); ALIAS_TEXT is the same list as text. | — | [3 values] |
| `ALIAS_TEXT` | string | required | Other names the headlines may use for the company, comma-separated ("Apple Inc, AAPL, iPhone"); the news search's aliases. | — | `"Apple Inc, AAPL, iPhone"` |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | required | The exchange the company is listed on (Nasdaq, NYSE). | one of `NYSE`, `Nasdaq` | `"Nasdaq"` |
| `SECTOR` | string | required | The company's sector (Technology, Financials …), a label of the pack. | seen: `Communication Services`, `Energy`, `Financials`, `Technology`, `Consumer Discretionary`, `Consumer Staples`, `Health Care`, `Industrials` | `"Technology"` |
| `COUNTRY` | string | required | The company's home country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (US, GB). | seen: `US`, `GB` | `"US"` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | required | The company's home economy: an id of the world-economy pack's economy kind (ECON-<ISO 3166-1 alpha-3>). | pattern `^ECON-`; links to `economy` | `"ECON-USA"` |
| `QUOTE_ID` | string | required | The company's quote: a QUOTE_ID of the quote kind (QUOTE-<ticker>). | pattern `^QUOTE-`; links to `quote` | `"QUOTE-AAPL"` |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | required | The company's headlines with the relevance filter on: a NEWS_ID of the news kind (NEWS-<name>). | pattern `^NEWS-`; links to `news` | `"NEWS-Apple"` |
| `NEWS_ALL_ID` | string | required | The company's headlines without the relevance filter: a NEWS_ID of the news kind (NEWS-<name>~all). | pattern `^NEWS-`; links to `news` | `"NEWS-Apple~all"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"reference"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |
| `_meta.live` | boolean | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | Part of the generator's provenance stamp; carried through, not read by Drishti. | — | `false` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 20 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `COMPANY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `COMPANY_ID`, `TICKER`, `NAME`, `ALIASES`, `ALIAS_TEXT`, `EXCHANGE`, `SECTOR`, `COUNTRY`, `ECONOMY`, `QUOTE_ID`, `NEWS_ID`, `NEWS_ALL_ID` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `COMPANY_ID` per snapshot.
- `COMPANY_ID` matches `^CO-`.
